about_the_game:
"Fraud Camp: Survival Escape" is a stealth-and-survival extraction-style adventure game.
Trapped inside a heavily guarded compound filled with patrolling security guards, sharp-nosed police dogs, and fully armed response units, you must gather supplies, break through blockades, and return safely to the dormitory after each mission.

1. Search

Explore the compound to find essential items that support survival or help you access restricted areas.
Abandoned staff lockers, old hospital corridors, emptied shops, shadowy warehouse corners, and deserted school zones may all hide vital supplies.

2. Combat / Confrontation

Use intelligence, tools, and the environment to fight against the compound’s strict security system.

Stealth: Avoid guard patrols and slip past police dogs using shadows and silent movement.
Limited force: Weapons can briefly disable enemies, but direct confrontation will trigger harsher pursuit.

3. Extraction

Once objectives are complete, you must carry your collected supplies back to the dorm safely.

But the escape is the real challenge:

  • Extraction triggers heightened alert levels

  • Guards tighten patrol routes, police dogs expand their search radius

  • Armed units set up roadblocks and hunt along potential escape paths

Every step is a test of pressure and nerves—can you escape under an intensified manhunt?
